name: engineering-knowledge-base
description: Use the shared EngineeringKnowledgeBase and its searchable web documentation to check for existing knowledge and record only genuinely new topics.

interface.longDescription: Connects any Codex project to the shared EngineeringKnowledgeBase and its browser-based documentation site. It reads the knowledge base rules, searches for an existing topic before writing, and records only new reusable knowledge without changing the rules from other projects.
defaultPrompt: Add this to the shared engineering knowledge base.
Check whether this topic already exists in the knowledge base.
Find related knowledge before recording this topic.
